name: Emerdata

summary.text: Emerdata Limited (Companies House number 10911848) is a UK company incorporated on 11 August 2017 with the SIC code for data processing, hosting and related activities. Its directors have included Alexander Nix and Julian Wheatland at incorporation, Rebekah Anne Mercer and Jennifer Lynne Mercer (appointed 16 March 2018), Johnson Chun Shun Ko (since resigned), Ahmad Al Khatib, Gary Ka Chun Tiu and Alexander Tayler. The DCMS Committee described it as the new ultimate holding company of the SCL companies and the major creditor of SCL Elections Ltd. Companies House records show the company entered administration on 9 December 2024.

facts.claim: The DCMS Committee's interim report described Emerdata as a new ultimate holding company incorporated in August 2017 and the major creditor of SCL Elections Ltd, owed over £6.3 million, and recommended that the National Crime Agency investigate the connections between SCL Elections Ltd and Emerdata Ltd; the final report repeated the recommendation.

openQuestions: The brief describes Johnson Chun Shun Ko as an executive of Frontier Services Group; only an unreliable wiki stated this in the sources opened, so it is not recorded as fact. A Frontier Services Group filing would settle it.

Did Emerdata acquire the assets or intellectual property of SCL Elections/Cambridge Analytica from the administrators or bankruptcy estates? Reports in 2018 said this was under consideration; no transfer record was located.
Jennifer Mercer's public role beyond her Emerdata directorship is not established; she is recorded here only as a named company director.
Johnson Chun Shun Ko's appointment and resignation dates were not visible; check the Companies House officer record.
